messages.subject: Re: width in geom_bar
parts:
That's a bug with stat_identity, but it's fixed for the upcoming release.


On Sun, Nov 11, 2012 at 6:10 AM, Manel Salamero <manels...@gmail.com> wrote:
I don't undestand why adding 'stat' inhibits 'width'. Here is an exemple:

dat <- data.frame(cat=c('a','b'), val=c(3,5))

ggplot(dat, aes(cat, val)) + geom_bar(width=0.5)
ggplot(dat, aes(cat, val)) + geom_bar(width=0.5, stat='identity')         # width doesn't work
ggplot(dat, aes(cat, val)) + geom_bar(aes(width=0.5), stat='identity')  # width works

Any suggestion?

Manel
